root.question: Is the variable value numeric (quantitative) or qualitative (categorical/attribute)?

quantitative.question: Does the variable represent a measurement on a continuous scale with infinite possible fractional values (e.g., age, pocket depth) or a count of discrete whole integers (e.g., number of implants, teeth count)?

continuous.description: Infinite real number values. Normal distribution test applicable.
continuous.recommended_summary: Mean ± Standard Deviation (if normal) or Median (IQR) (if skewed).

discrete.description: Countable integer values. Usually skewed distribution.

qualitative.question: Do the categories have a natural ranking/order (e.g. oral hygiene: poor/fair/good) or are they purely descriptive labels with no logical order (e.g., gender, smoking status, study group)?

nominal.question: Are there exactly two categories (binary) or more than two?
